evidence: Static check per quality-checks.md s25 ('every prompt opens http://localhost:3000 and directs the judge to the Playwright MCP tool') holds for all five dimensions. Each prompt.md line 1 reads 'Open http://localhost:3000 using Playwright. ... Use rendered UI and ordinary browser-observed product data only. Never inspect app source, bundles, filesystem, database files or implementation code. No shell or private-file probes. Discover routes and controls by intent, not assumed names.' (tests/gates/render/prompt.md:1, gates/constraints/prompt.md:1, scored/functional/prompt.md:1 [adds 'No shell. Use restart_app only once, at the end of protocol D.'], scored/polish/prompt.md:1, scored/visual/prompt.md:1). Every judge.toml wires [[judge.mcp_servers]] name='playwright', command='playwright-mcp', args --headless --isolated --executable-path=/usr/local/bin/chromium (render/constraints/polish/visual judge.toml:8-12; functional:8-12 plus verifier restart server 14-18); tests/Dockerfile:19 installs @playwright/mcp@0.0.79 and links chromium (33-38). app_context.md:4 'URL: http://localhost:3000', substituted into every */*/prompt.md by test.sh:198-200. Not satisfiable from source, memory or first paint: render gate requires an incorrect then correct sign-in and a usable workspace ('A static picture or only a health response is insufficient', gates/render/judge.toml:23); constraints gate requires a UI-created job+candidate read back in a new independent browser context (judge.toml:23); functional/polish/visual prompts restate the same write-then-independent-context-readback gate (functional:11-13, polish:11-12, visual:11-12) and zero/Likert-1 on failure; functional protocols S..D are interaction sequences with request capture/replay and a real restart_app; polish rows require live cross-context updates with document.activeElement/scroll reads; visual requires a multi-surface read-only tour (Board, card details, Conversations with Noor's long thread, Activity, candidate view in independent context; visual/prompt.md:14), not a first paint. Missing observation is scored 0/Likert-1 'NOT EXERCISED' rather than guessed (each prompt's penultimate paragraph). Compared with the template prompts ('Evaluate the live application at http://localhost:3000 using Playwright MCP. Use only rendered browser behavior.'), the task keeps the same direction and strengthens the source prohibition. Adversarial probes: (a) broken app that could pass - a static shell or localStorage-only app cannot pass any gate, because each requires a server write observed from a fresh browser context; a judge reading /app source instead of browsing is prohibited textually. (b) conforming alternative that could fail - an app with different routes/labels is protected by 'Discover routes and controls by intent, not assumed names' and app_context.md:33-34. Residual risk (why risk=true): no configured claude-code judge run exists for this candidate (raw-evidence-index scope: 'Full configured grading/workload ... are absent'; the indexed workspace.cjs is a scripted Playwright driver, not a judge transcript), so it is unmeasured whether the judge actually drives the browser rather than reading /app (test.sh:85-86 makes /app world-readable and claude-code retains file tools; only the prompt text forbids it) or echoing the expected seeded facts the functional prompt itself states (functional/prompt.md:25 gives the Platform Engineer order and Noor's note text, which a non-browsing judge could restate). These are evidence gaps, not demonstrated defects of the prompt text.
